title: Regularity of a Coordinate-Times-Majority Function
statement: For every natural number $m$, consider the function on $\{\pm1\}^{2m+2}$ that multiplies the first coordinate by the majority sign of the remaining $2m+1$ coordinates, with ties assigned the positive sign. Every Fourier coefficient indexed by a nonempty coordinate set has absolute value at most $1/\sqrt{2m+1}$.
